records.title: Dispatch Loom
records.subtitle: Dispatch reconciliation tool
records.summary: Personally designed and built an operational dispatch reconciliation tool using a Python parser and SQL checks. Gathered requirements from warehouse supervisors, explained validation failures, and used Git and PostgreSQL. Operators compared an overnight spreadsheet with a daily export; the tool surfaced understandable exceptions, including late-file warnings and visible empty rows. Supervisors made final dispatch decisions.
